# DevSwat — Full Platform Reference

> Agentic AI infrastructure for building, running, and scheduling server and local agents. Built-in DevSwat IDE powered by AI code execution intelligence. Fully self-hosted with AST/SAST code analysis, invariant simulation, and two blockchains — internal audit logging and decentralized frontier LLM training with P2P weight shards.

Website: https://dev-swat.com
GitHub: https://github.com/DevSwat-ResonantGenesis
Founder: Louie Nemesh

---

## Platform Statistics

- ~550,000 lines of code (310K Python backend, 240K TypeScript/React frontend)
- Full-stack AI agent infrastructure (production-deployed)
- 662 React components across 85+ frontend routes
- 4,384 API endpoints, 120+ database tables
- 9 proprietary IP systems, unlimited LLM providers (connect any model)
- Production-deployed on DigitalOcean with Nginx, PostgreSQL, Redis

---

## 1. Agents OS

Build, run, and schedule autonomous AI agents on server or local hardware.

### Features
- Agent creation and execution framework with autonomous daemon and goal pursuit
- World model and agent reasoning
- Multi-agent orchestration: voting protocol, debate protocol, chain protocol
- Swarm controller for team management
- Project builder agent
- Tool execution with sandbox boundaries
- Delegation and cross-service escalation
- Agent scheduling (cron, interval, webhook triggers)
- Agent sessions with full execution traces, waterfall views, cost tracking, safety flags
- Governed (25 steps max, approval gates) and Unbounded (200 steps, no checks) modes

### Agent Architect
Standalone orchestrator for building agents autonomously:
- Intent classification → routing → response via SSE streaming
- Modes: brainstorm, control, review, diagnose
- Blueprint generation, agent creation, execution, polling, scheduling
- LLM: Groq primary, OpenAI fallback

### Agent Marketplace
- Publish, discover, purchase, and review agents
- Agent templates and workflow designer

URL: https://dev-swat.com/agents
API: POST /api/v1/agents, GET /api/v1/agents, POST /api/v1/agents/{id}/run

## 3. OpenClaw — Federated Agent Connector

Local-first agent runtime. Tools execute on YOUR hardware. Data never leaves your machine.

### 137 Tools Across 15 Categories
- **Search & Web (11)**: web_search (local DuckDuckGo), fetch_url, read_webpage, deep_research, reddit_search, image_search, news_search, places_search, youtube_search, wikipedia, read_many_pages
- **Memory — LOCAL (9)**: memory_read, memory_write, memory_search (SQLite FTS5 on your machine), hash_sphere_search, hash_sphere_anchor, hash_sphere_list_anchors, hash_sphere_hash, hash_sphere_resonance, memory_stats
- **Code Visualizer / SAST (8)**: code_visualizer_scan, functions, trace, governance, graph, pipeline, filter, by_type
- **Agents OS (24)**: agents CRUD, sessions, metrics, scheduling, architect tools (plan, create_agent, assign_goal, create_schedule, create_webhook, set_autonomy, list_available_tools, list_providers)
- **Media Generation (3)**: generate_image (DALL-E), generate_audio (TTS), generate_music
- **Integrations (9)**: Gmail, Slack, Google Calendar, Google Drive, Figma, Sigma, SendGrid
- **GitHub (9)**: repos, files, PRs, issues, commits, comments
- **Git Operations (5)**: clone, branch, merge, push, pull
- **State Physics (21)**: full universe management, physics config, entropy injection, autonomous agents, experiments
- **Community / Rabbit (12)**: posts, communities, comments, voting, search
- **Developer (4)**: execute_code (local), http_request, external_http_request, dev_tool
- **Utilities (6)**: weather, stock_crypto, generate_chart, visualize, get_current_time, get_system_info
- **Platform API (2)**: platform_api_search (~383 endpoints), platform_api_call
- **Filesystem (10)**: file CRUD, grep_search, find_by_name, run_command, command_status
- **Tool Management (6)**: create_tool, list_tools, delete_tool, update_tool, auto_build_tool, check_tool_exists

### Self-Creating Tools
Agents can create their own tools at runtime:
1. check_tool_exists — search 137+ built-in + custom tools
2. auto_build_tool — LLM designs tool spec from natural language description
3. AST safety scan — validates no SSRF, no forbidden URLs, valid schema
4. Registered in DB — immediately available platform-wide

### Privacy Model
- Local tools: web_search, fetch_url, memory, execute_code → run on YOUR machine
- Cloud fallback only for OAuth tools (Google Calendar, Slack) and GPU tools (image generation)
- Server receives only: tool name + timing + final answer
- Memory stored at ~/.openclaw/data/memory.db (SQLite + FTS5)
- ALL traffic is outbound HTTPS. Platform NEVER connects to you.

URL: https://dev-swat.com/download-openclaw
GitHub: https://github.com/DevSwat-ResonantGenesis/RG_OpenClaw

## 4. Code Visualizer (AST/SAST)

Standalone AST-based code analysis service. Parses Python, JavaScript, and TypeScript codebases into navigable graph structures.

### Features
- AST parsing: Python (ast module), JavaScript/TypeScript (regex-based analyzer)
- Codebase graph: nodes (services, files, classes, functions, endpoints) and connections (imports, calls, inheritance)
- GitHub scanning: clone and analyze repos via OAuth (single or multi-repo comparison)
- Archive upload: .zip/.tar.gz codebases
- Governance engine: reachability contracts, dead code classification, drift detection
- Multi-project comparison: diff, heat maps, instability metrics, evolution timeline
- Graph Janitor Agent: autonomous graph cleanup proposals
- Saved analyses with per-user PostgreSQL persistence
- Credit-based billing per scan

URL: https://dev-swat.com/code-visualizer
API: POST /api/v1/scan/github, POST /api/v1/scan/github/multi, POST /api/v1/scan/upload, POST /api/analysis/{id}/governance

Completely novel approach to state management using physics simulation.

### Features
- N-body particle system with gravity, repulsion, electromagnetic, and resonance forces

- Core invariants: mass conservation, energy conservation, identity uniqueness, causality, trust bounds
- Identity layer (DSID), State/Memory layer, Economic/Temporal layer
- Real-time Three.js visualization with interactive exploration
- Force-directed graph layouts for dependency analysis
- Entropy injection and perturbation events
- Autonomous agent spawning and experimentation

URL: https://dev-swat.com/state-physics

## 7. ResonantChat — 68-Module AI Pipeline

The most sophisticated chat pipeline in any SaaS product.

### Features
- 68 processing modules
- Hallucination detection: system prompt grounding, LLM-as-judge, knowledge base cross-referencing
- Evidence graph construction: links every claim to source material with citation chains
- Neural Skill Classifier: trained MLP on all-MiniLM-L6-v2 embeddings (384-dim → 256 → 128 → 14 classes), ~5ms inference, active learning
- 9 modular AI skills: web search, code analysis, memory, agent orchestration, social posting, HTTP API
- Multi-provider fallback across unlimited LLM providers with smart routing
- SSE streaming with quality metrics overlay
- Debate engine, error correction, multi-provider chunking
- IDE completions endpoint
- Provider status monitoring

## 8. Three-Blockchain Architecture

### 8a. Internal Blockchain (RG_DSID_Blockchain)
- DSID-P (Digital State Identity Protocol) for content hashing and lineage
- Block mining with configurable intervals
- Transaction graph with full history and lineage tracking
- Audit chain for immutable audit trail of all platform operations
- External anchoring to Base Sepolia (periodic merkle root)
- Distributed consensus protocol
- Smart contract execution
- Identity registry (Crypto Identity Layer 4)
- DSID backfill for existing identities

### 8b. Training Network Chain (RG_TrainingNet_Chain)
Sovereign distributed blockchain — own chain, not riding on another.
- Raft consensus: leader election, log replication, heartbeats
- TCP P2P: gossip discovery, block/transaction propagation, training messages
- Full blockchain: block production, merkle trees, fork handling, state machine
- Transaction types: transfer, set (state update), agent_action, training_gradient
- Environment: NODE_ID, CONSENSUS_PEERS, P2P_PORT, BLOCK_TIME (10s default), MAX_TX_PER_BLOCK (100)

### 8c. Cross-chain Bridge (Planned)
- $RGT currently on sovereign chain (chain ID: resonant-genesis-external-1)
- Base/ETH mainnet bridge planned as network matures

---

## 9. Decentralized Mining Network

Real GPU training for frontier LLM models. Not fake mining or idle hashing.

### Architecture
- **RG_TrainingNet_Mining**: Training orchestration, gradient compression (Top-K sparsification, 100-1000x), FedAvg aggregation, reward distribution
- **RG_miner_app**: Standalone open-source mining client (AGPL-3.0). Real PyTorch forward/backward passes on GQA+RoPE+SwiGLU transformer.
- **RG_TrainingNet_Lighthouse**: Bootstrap/discovery node. TCP protocol for peer registration, heartbeat, discovery, eviction.

### Pipeline-Parallel Training
- Models split into layer groups across miners (pipeline parallelism)
- 1F1B microbatch scheduling (same as DeepSpeed/Meta)
- With 32 microbatches and 4 stages: 91% pipeline efficiency
- Models supported: 1B to 405B parameters

### P2P Weight Transfer
- WebRTC signaling for NAT traversal — no manual port forwarding
- Direct miner-to-miner DataChannels for weight shard transfer
- Liquid redistribution when miners disconnect

### $RGT Token Economics
- Closed utility economy: earn by mining, spend on platform services (IDE, LLM APIs, agents)
- Not intended for exchange trading — value from real platform usage
- Halving schedule: 100 → 50 → 25 → 12.5 $RGT per year
- Miner tiers: Genesis Validator (1.5x), Core Contributor (1.25x), Standard Miner (1.0x)

### Proof-of-Training (5-Layer Security)
1. Internal Key Auth — only mining service can call credit endpoint
2. Gradient Hash Required — must actually process a gradient
3. HMAC-SHA256 Signature — mining service signs, crypto service verifies
4. Replay Protection — each gradient_hash credited exactly once (UNIQUE constraint)
5. Reward Cap — max 500 $RGT per credit call

### On-Chain Recording
Every gradient submission recorded as training_gradient transaction on the sovereign blockchain with Raft consensus and Merkle-tree validation.

URL: https://dev-swat.com/download-miner
GitHub: https://github.com/DevSwat-ResonantGenesis/RG_miner_app

## 10. RARA — Governance Layer

Resident Autonomous Runtime Agent. Internal platform governance (admin-only).

### Features
- Invariant Engine: graph constraint enforcement via AST Analysis (structural, semantic, temporal)
- Kill Switch: emergency freeze/stop/reset
- Mutation Executor: atomic mutations with rollback
- Governance Engine: decision explainability and audit trail, blast radius calculation
- Capability Engine: agent capability enforcement with trust decay (capabilities can only decay, never expand autonomously)
- Compliance: EU AI Act, SOC2, policy enforcement (minimal/standard/strict profiles)
- DISD Protocol: decentralized secure identity messaging
- Cryptographic receipts: tamper-proof mutation receipts
- Quorum Authority: multi-agent consensus
- Epoch Authority: time-based governance
- Snapshot Engine: system state snapshots and restore
- Physics Governance Bridge: deterministic bridge from physics state to governance actions

## 13. Additional Services

- **Auth**: JWT, Google/GitHub OAuth, MFA/TOTP, role management (free/pro/enterprise/owner)
- **Gateway**: Reverse proxy to 30+ services, JWT middleware, rate limiting, SSE/WebSocket support
- **Notifications**: Multi-channel (in-app, email, push, SMS)
- **Workflow Engine**: Visual workflow builder, execution engine, event sourcing
- **Storage**: S3-compatible file storage with presigned URLs
- **Sandbox Runner**: Docker-isolated code execution, multi-language sandboxes
- **Crypto Service**: $RGT wallet management, token operations, Proof-of-Training verification
- **Cognitive Service**: Anomaly detection, clustering, workflow triggering
- **ML Service**: Model registry, training jobs, inference endpoints
- **Rabbit**: Social platform with communities, posts, comments, voting

---

## Infrastructure

- **Docker Compose**: 33 containers on unified bridge network
- **Nginx**: Reverse proxy with SSL termination, static file serving
- **PostgreSQL**: Primary database with multi-service schema isolation
- **Redis**: Caching, session storage, rate limiting
- **DigitalOcean**: Single droplet deployment (scales to Kubernetes)

## Tech Stack

- **Backend**: Python, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, Alembic, Pydantic, Celery, asyncio, httpx, WebSockets
- **Frontend**: React 18, TypeScript, Vite, Zustand, Three.js, D3.js, Monaco Editor, CSS Modules
- **AI/ML**: OpenAI SDK, Anthropic SDK, Groq SDK, Mistral AI, Cohere, sentence-transformers, PyTorch
- **DevOps**: Docker, Nginx, Certbot, GitHub Actions, DigitalOcean
